title: GxP-Agent：利用流程DAG拓扑实现可靠的临床试验编程LLM智能体
summary: GxP-Agent是一个多智能体系统，将监管流程编码为有向无环图（DAG），将临床数据集生成分解为15个领域特定节点，配备验证门和条件重试。在CDISC-Bench基准上，使用Claude Sonnet 4.6实现100%结构匹配，优于所有单智能体和平面多智能体方法，证明图拓扑编码领域知识是可靠合规编程的关键。
summary_en: GxP-Agent is a multi-agent system encoding regulatory process as a DAG, decomposing clinical dataset generation into 15 domain-specific nodes with validation gates and retry. On CDISC-Bench, it achieves 100% structural match with Claude Sonnet 4.6, outperforming all single-agent and flat multi-agent approaches, showing graph topology encoding domain knowledge is key for reliable compliant programming.
